title: CreateRobotRequest
description: POST /v1/organizations/{org_id}/robots request body. Owner-only. A robot is bound to its organization for its whole lifetime.

profile_ref.description: Optional reference to an externally owned robot profile, e.g. 'agent-repo:my-robot@1.2.0'.

appearance.description: Console visual identity only; independent of Agent profiles. Null uses the default robot icon. Images are PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 data URLs, at most 256 KiB decoded; signatures must match MIME type. No remote URLs or SVG.
